name: MVImgNet: Large-scale Multi-view Image Dataset for 3D Vision
description: MVImgNet is a massive real-world multi-view dataset designed to bridge 2D visual representation learning with 3D object understanding. It contains 219,188 multi-view video clips capturing everyday objects across 238 categories. Over 6.5 million frames were processed through Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines to recover camera trajectories, sparse 3D point clouds, and dense depth estimations, supporting multi-view 3D reconstruction, novel-view synthesis, and neural radiance field modeling.
